dialogues.jp:
「冒頭に戻り、曲の終わり又はｆｉｎｅと書か
　れたところまで繰り返す」
dialogues.en:
"To return to the start of a musical piece, often refining
certain notes during the repetition."
dialogues.text:
"To return to the start of a musical piece, often refining
certain notes during the repetition."

dialogues.jp: 早歩き？　普通？　ゆっくり？

こっくり、こっくりしていた俺は、机にオデコ
をぶつけて目を覚ます。
dialogues.en: My forehead hit my table as I nearly fell asleep.
dialogues.text: My forehead hit my table as I nearly fell asleep.

dialogues.en: I slap my cheeks a few times.
dialogues.text: I slap my cheeks a few times.

dialogues.jp:
「だいたい、うちの学園も一夜漬け泣かせだよ
　な。なにも試験を２日間ですることないだろ
　うに」
dialogues.en:
"And I have another night of cramming to look forward to
tomorrow... if only the exams weren't over two days."
dialogues.text:
"And I have another night of cramming to look forward to
tomorrow... if only the exams weren't over two days."

dialogues.jp:
マジで死ぬっての……まぁ、普段の実力を計る
というのなら、上手いシステムだろうが。
dialogues.en:
I feel like death itself... I really should've been able to
predict how much studying I can take...
dialogues.text:
I feel like death itself... I really should've been able to
predict how much studying I can take...

dialogues.jp:
「うう、いつ寝てしまうかわかったもんじゃな
　いな。非常に危険だ」
dialogues.en:
"Ugh, I don't know when I'd fall asleep tonight... better
set this now just in case..."
dialogues.text:
"Ugh, I don't know when I'd fall asleep tonight... better
set this now just in case..."

dialogues.jp:
｛・・・／落ちる｝前に、目覚ましだけはセットしておくか
な。
dialogues.en: I set the alarm clock in front of me.
dialogues.text: I set the alarm clock in front of me.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、勉強を続けた。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、勉強を続けた。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、寝た。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I slept.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I slept.

dialogues.jp: 試験という事で、音楽の勉強をした。
dialogues.en: I studied for music exams tonight.
dialogues.text: I studied for music exams tonight.

dialogues.jp:
ダカーポの意味は、“冒頭に戻り、曲の終わり又
はｆｉｎｅと書かれたところまで繰り返す”だそ
うな。
dialogues.en:
The meaning of Da Capo was "to return to the start of a
musical piece, often refining certain notes during the
repetition.".
dialogues.text:
The meaning of Da Capo was "to return to the start of a
musical piece, often refining certain notes during the
repetition.".
